anomalies.message: CPU load average is high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or inefficiency.
AI module has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it might be inactive or misconfigured.
Trading activity is minimal with no active trades and zero total profit/loss, which might indicate low market activity or system inactivity.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average and improve system performance.
Review AI module configuration and ensure it is properly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure the platform is actively engaging in profitable trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct a performance audit on CPU usage to identify and address bottlenecks or inefficiencies.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns or failures, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Verify AI module settings and logs to ensure it is functioning as expected and contributing to trading decisions.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity may result in missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Analyze current market conditions and strategy performance to adjust trading parameters for better engagement.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring active and profitable trading is crucial for platform success and user satisfaction.
